question.text: An investor with a grievance against a Research Analyst can lodge a complaint through which of the following channels?

answer.text: Directly with the Research Analyst, and if unresolved, through SCORES 2.0 / RAASB, SMARTODR, or a physical complaint to SEBI
Only listed companies for non-payment of dividends

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook channels Research Analyst grievances first to the RA itself, and if the investor is not satisfied, escalation can move through SCORES 2.0 / RAASB review, SMARTODR for online conciliation or arbitration, or a physical complaint to SEBI. The Trap: The other options narrow the complaint channel to a single class of entity (exchanges, MFs, listed companies), which does not match the RA grievance framework described in the source. Note: The checked workbook pages frame this in the RA context; broader SCORES coverage of every regulated entity category needs a separate cited source if used.
